description.value:
Trigger Your Rig, or an ally within 30 feet, takes damage.

Cost 1 charge of Ghost-Static

You slap a patch on before the damage finishes landing. Reduce the damage taken by 2 plus your level. This is a shield-like intervention, not a heal — it cannot restore Hit Points already lost.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 3 (reaction handing a new usable damage-mitigation ability) + [NO-SPECIALRESOURCE] for the 1-Ghost-Static cost + [RIG-GENERIC-AMBIGUOUS] for the "or your Rig" half of the trigger. No rule element performs a flat reduction to an already-in-progress damage instance on a reaction trigger (that requires a script/macro hook, same category as Shield Block's built-in system support, which this class does not have).
